description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode III (Fire, Dark)] and [Revived Vengeance Mode] to the user

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Twin Element Mode III (Fire, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Dark 2 with Stacking] after using a Fire/Dark ability

description.name: Revived Vengeance Mode
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 2], [Instant Cast 2] and [100% Critical 2] when HP fall below 20%, removed after triggering
